## Change

## Visual evidence

For user-visible changes, publish inspected current-head screenshots with `scripts/pr-visual-evidence.py` (a clip only when requested). Non-UI changes can remove this section. See [the evidence workflow](https://github.com/zigdanis/WhoGaveWhat/blob/master/docs/pr-evidence.md).
